PullRequest.Title: chat: let archived chats in remote windows continue in Copilot
PullRequest.Body:
Relates #342830

## User impact

Users who work in Remote-SSH (also WSL, Dev Containers and other remote windows) report that their chats "disappeared" and they're not offered any way to move them to Copilot, even though the session files are still on disk.

Before #342938, every Local chat they opened in a remote window was archived by a move that lost its history. Those chats are now archived. With the default filter (**Archived** unchecked), the stacked session list in the Chat view hides archived chats entirely, and the side-by-side layout shows them only in a collapsed **Archived** section. Opening one shows a read-only chat with no action, because archived chats under the managed policy got no banner action and Move to Copilot rejected archived sources. #342938 stopped new chats from being lost but left the already archived ones stranded.

After this change, an archived Local chat in a remote window offers **Continue in Copilot**, like any other chat there. It opens a new Copilot chat with the conversation attached as context, and the original stays where it is.

## Changes

- The policy banner keeps its action on archived chats when the Agent Host can't import history. In local windows, an archived chat was already moved with its history, so nothing changes there.
- Continue in Copilot accepts an archived source when it only attaches a transcript, since that path never archives or changes the source.
- Accessibility help mentions that archived chats offer the action too.

## Still a fallback

This is the same transcript fallback as #342938: context, not editable history, and trimmed for long chats. Turn-by-turn import for remote windows is tracked in #342830.

Users still need to find these chats: check **Archived** in the session list's filter picker, or open the collapsed **Archived** section in the side-by-side layout. Nothing records which chats the old move archived, so they can't be unarchived automatically without also unarchiving chats users archived themselves.

## How to test

1. In a remote window (Remote-SSH, or **Remote-TestResolver: New TestResolver Window** in Code OSS) with a policy that requires Copilot, for example `{"sandbox":{"enabled":true}}` in the managed settings file, archive a Local chat that has history.
2. Check **Archived** in the session list's filter picker and open the chat. The banner shows **Continue in Copilot**.
3. Click it. A new Copilot chat opens with a **Previous conversation** attachment and the draft; the original stays archived.
4. In a local window, an archived chat still shows no action.

Validation:

- `./scripts/test.sh --run` with `chatContinueInCopilotAction`, `chatWidget`, `agentHostPolicyContinuation`, `chatReadOnlyBanner` and `agentHostProtocolClient` test files: **passed**, 550 passing, 4 pending. Without the fix, the 3 new checks fail.
- `npm run typecheck-client`: **passed**.
- `npm run eslint -- <changed files>`: **passed**.

*🤖 Authored with GitHub Copilot on behalf of @rwoll.*

Scenarios.Scenario: Open an archived Local chat in a remote managed-policy window
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Binding the chat model reads the archived observable, computes policy state, and updates the existing read-only banner. The diff adds only a synchronous capability-property check and exposes the existing action; no subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, or network work is placed on chat-open critical path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant work per model bind or archive-state notification; independent of transcript length and session-list size except for pre-existing in-memory session lookup.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One autorun per bound widget/model. Session-change notifications already drove the same read-only update before the diff; the change does not add listeners or parallel work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No new cache. The capability is a stable in-memory property and archive state uses the existing session model.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed condition and its autorun/setReadOnly call path are directly traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Banner rendering cost varies with widget state, but the diff does not increase rerender cardinality or add layout reads/writes beyond the pre-existing update.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: the action becomes visible without adding expensive work to opening or rendering the archived chat.

Scenarios.Scenario: Click Continue in Copilot for an archived remote Local chat
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The action synchronously translates source requests and constructs a transcript, then awaits Copilot provider resolution and opens one new Copilot session before restoring the draft. These steps are required before the destination can be shown.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve/activate the Copilot chat-session provider via extension activation when cold.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one activation attempt per explicit action; warm runs return from the registered content-provider cache.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The archived unsupported-host scenario had no banner action and the archived guard rejected direct invocation before provider resolution.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Cold provider activation blocks opening the destination; warm provider resolution is in-memory.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Open and resolve one untitled Copilot session through the contributed session provider/Agent Host path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One destination session per successful explicit continuation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No destination was opened for an archived unsupported-host chat because the action was not offered and the archived guard rejected it.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Destination session materialization must finish before its draft is populated and the action completes.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Synchronous transcript preparation scales with request count and response text size; the attached result is capped at 20,000 characters. This implementation and cost already apply to every transcript-only continuation and are not changed by this PR; the diff extends the explicitly requested workflow to archived sources.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The static pending map coalesces duplicate invocations for the same source resource. Different source resources are independent, but the realistic trigger is a user click on one open chat rather than collection fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Provider registration is cached after cold activation. In-flight continuation is coalesced per source resource; transcript data is computed once per explicit attempt and not retained after draft transfer beyond the destination attachment.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High for the one-action call path, transcript scaling, provider activation, and per-resource coalescing; exact Agent Host startup latency depends on warm state.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Very large archived histories can make the pre-existing full-history conversion/allocation noticeable, but the diff neither changes its per-action complexity nor creates repeated or automatic invocation, so it does not meet the causality threshold for a finding.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: the new boundaries are a single, user-requested destination creation with duplicate-click coalescing. The potentially unbounded intermediate transcript preparation is pre-existing and not materially amplified in frequency or cardinality by the diff.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: Accessibility help constructs localized text in memory when invoked; the diff appends one sentence to an existing help paragraph.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant additional string content, independent of chat history or session count.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single synchronous help-text construction per invocation; no queue or parallel work.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High from the changed localized string.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed all five changed patches and traced archived-chat binding, explicit transcript continuation, provider/session boundaries, accessibility help, test-only changes, cache state, and concurrency. No high-confidence diff-introduced performance issue was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
